name: Fludarabine
halfLifeSource: FDA label for Fludarabine Phosphate (fludarabine phosphate), Clinical Pharmacology 12.3 Pharmacokinetics — t½ ≈ 20 h
halfLifeNotes: Terminal half-life of 2-fluoro-ara-A (fludarabine itself) in cancer patients; the administered phosphate prodrug is dephosphorylated within minutes of infusion, so this is the measurable circulating species.
